editorial.description_en: The trough between two waves, where the water is deepest in colour and briefest in view.
editorial.description_ja: 波と波のあいだのような、緑みのある青。

provenance.derivation: Editorial construction, not a measurement. Specified in OKLCh as L 0.672, C 0.080, h 228.0° and converted to canonical D65 XYZ by @irodora/color-spaces 0.1.0 (oklchToXyz), rounded to six decimal places. Re-derivable from this sentence alone.
provenance.editorialNotes: Name coined by Irodora: 波 (nami, wave) + 間 (ma, the space between). It is not asserted to be a traditional Japanese colour name, and the hyphenated romaji marks it as a constructed compound (ADR-0065). "Between Waves" is an editorial decision about what communicates in English, not a literal translation of 波間. Relations asserted from measured proximity under the current engine, not from a source: related is the three nearest in CIELAB — natsu-zora at ΔE00 4.7, oki-nagi at ΔE00 6.2, ko-men at ΔE00 6.6. complementary is the entry nearest the opposite OKLCh hue (48°), within 22°. historicalVariants is empty: this entry makes no historical claim to vary from.
